facts.text: A sensor simulation tool produces artificial camera images, radar returns, lidar point clouds or ultrasonic echoes from a virtual scene, allowing braking software to be tested without a real sensor.
facts.quote: A sensor simulation tool produces artificial camera images, radar returns, lidar point clouds or ultrasonic echoes from a virtual scene, so the braking software can be tested without a real sensor.

facts.text: For automatic braking, sensor presence does not establish sensor credibility: "radar supported" can mean a perfect object list, simple geometric ray casting, tuned statistical detections or raw radio-signal simulation, and these levels are not interchangeable.
facts.quote: A checkbox saying "radar supported" may mean anything from a perfect list of objects, to simple geometric ray casting, to tuned statistical detections, to simulation of the raw radio signal, and for automatic braking those levels are not interchangeable [Chapter 11].

facts.text: The sensor-simulation realism ladder comprises ideal object lists, geometric ray casting, phenomenological models tuned to measurements, physics-based raw-signal models using ray tracing and material properties, and full-wave electromagnetic solvers.
facts.quote: The ladder of realism runs: ideal object lists; geometric ray casting; phenomenological models tuned to measurements; physics-based raw-signal models using ray tracing and material properties; and full-wave electromagnetic solvers

facts.text: Full-wave electromagnetic solvers are far too slow for sensor simulation of whole job sites.
facts.quote: full-wave electromagnetic solvers, far too slow for whole job sites [Chapter 6].

facts.text: dSPACE AURELION provides camera, ray-traced radar, lidar, infrared and ultrasonic simulation, with a material database.
facts.quote: dSPACE AURELION (camera, ray-traced radar, lidar, infrared, ultrasonic, with a material database)

facts.text: Synopsys AVxcelerate Sensors, formerly Ansys, provides camera, lidar, radar and thermal simulation; co-simulation with CarMaker and CARLA is documented.
facts.quote: Synopsys AVxcelerate Sensors, formerly Ansys (camera, lidar, radar, thermal; co-simulation with CarMaker and CARLA documented)

facts.text: Commercial sensor-simulation tools named in the booklet include Simcenter Prescan sensor models and rFpro's camera pipeline.
facts.quote: Simcenter Prescan sensor models; rFpro's camera pipeline

facts.text: Persival builds sensor models to the ASAM Open Simulation Interface (OSI) standard, packages them as Functional Mock-up Units (FMUs), and correlates them against real sensor output.
facts.quote: Persival, which builds sensor models to the ASAM Open Simulation Interface (OSI) standard, packaged as Functional Mock-up Units (FMUs), and correlates them against real sensor output.

facts.text: The booklet lists RTX sensors in Isaac Sim, Chrono::Sensor and CARLA's sensors as open-source sensor-simulation options.
facts.quote: Open-source options are the RTX sensors in Isaac Sim, Chrono::Sensor and CARLA's sensors

facts.text: Physics-based ultrasonic simulation was not found in the listed open-source options: RTX sensors in Isaac Sim, Chrono::Sensor and CARLA's sensors.
facts.quote: Open-source options are the RTX sensors in Isaac Sim, Chrono::Sensor and CARLA's sensors; physics-based ultrasonic simulation in these was not found.

facts.text: None of the named commercial sensor-simulation tools—dSPACE AURELION, Synopsys AVxcelerate Sensors, Simcenter Prescan, rFpro and Persival—had public off-road validation.
facts.quote: None of the commercial tools had public off-road validation [Chapter 11].

facts.text: RadaRays is a real-time radar ray tracer whose authors mounted a radar on a wheel loader in a hall; the booklet identified this as the most directly relevant heavy-machine result found.
facts.quote: RadaRays, a real-time radar ray tracer whose authors mounted a radar on a wheel loader in a hall, the most directly relevant heavy-machine result found

facts.text: RadSimReal and Sim2Radar are research tools discussed for the radar gap between simulation and reality.
facts.quote: RadSimReal and Sim2Radar, on the radar gap between simulation and reality

facts.text: SplatAD and the NVIDIA NuRec engine rebuild scenes from recordings with Gaussian splatting.
facts.quote: SplatAD and the NVIDIA NuRec engine, which rebuild scenes from recordings with Gaussian splatting

facts.text: LiDARsim-style meshing from machine logs is a research approach discussed in the booklet.
Boreal3D provides synthetic forest lidar plots.
Sensor and environment fidelity is the hardest uncertainty in the collision-mitigation validation program and is weakest in the risk-critical conditions of dust, fog, snow, rain, glare and darkness.
facts.quote: Sensor and environment fidelity is the hardest uncertainty in the whole program, and it is weakest exactly where the risk is: dust, fog, snow, rain, glare and darkness [Chapter 13].

facts.text: ASAM states that no standardized metrics exist to assess the quality of sensor simulation.
facts.quote: ASAM itself states that no standardized metrics exist to assess the quality of sensor simulation [Chapter 11].
